# PTS Datamining: 6 new collectors for your CAMP (Patch 59/60)

![PTS Datamining: 6 new collectors for your CAMP (Patch 59/60)](/uploads/489_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Yesterday on April 4th, 2025 the new PTS went live. Fishing can now be tested there and there are various changes to the perks and legendary effects. There are also new items hidden under the hood. Here are 6 new collectors expected to be released on the Atom Shop.

## The fish trap

Catches small and medium normal fish. Not rare ones.

Description:

Why should you stand on your feet when you can just let the fish fall into your trap?

Generates fish.

## Life Bait Barrel

Generates common and improved lures. Bait is required for the new fishing feature.

Description:

Make sure you have a supply of live bait in your C.A.M.P. so that nothing stands in the way of your next fishing trip.

Generates fishing lures.

## Games cabinet (Vault-Tec)

Description:

It's time for a game night in the Vault again!

Produces pre-war board games.

## Games cabinet (red)

Description:

It's time to plan a game night again! Who gets to choose the first game?

Produces pre-war board games.

## Mixomat

Generates cement, like the cement truck.

Description:

You're in luck: This broken Mixomat still has some cement in the back.

Generates cement.

## The miracle whirlwind

Actually supposed to generate paint cans.

Current bug: Resource is set to board games (should be fixed within the PTS)

Description:

Time to get the C.A.M.P. to repaint. Prepare well!

Generates paint cans.
